tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Return public Altair page paths, URLs, titles and descriptions. Use this to discover pages before read_page.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Return a public Altair page's full markdown with its path, URL, title and description. Use a path from list_pages when you need the page content.

path.description: Site path from list_pages, e.g. /indicators; 1–2048 characters.

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: Return the latest S&P 500 sector breadth and S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) constituent percentages above their 20-session simple moving averages, with SPX, NDX and SOX price-index benchmark levels (no dividends). History uses the loader's constituent lists, not point-in-time membership. Optionally choose 1–252 recent trading sessions; default 20.

days.description: Recent trading sessions to return in history; integer from 1 to 252, default 20.

tools.name: get_market_indicators
tools.description: Return the latest readings of ten factor indicators and TD Sequential 9 (daily and weekly) for the S&P 500 (SPX), Nasdaq-100 (NDX) and PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) price indices: value, reading, bullish/neutral/bearish signal, the rule's bands and the previous session's value and signal, with each rule's source and its 2005–2026 S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 evidence. Signals are rule readings, not forecasts; several are contrarian, and SOX implied volatility is Cboe's semiconductor ETF index VXSMH. Five-year histories are at /api/market/indicators.

tools.name: get_ticker_indicators
tools.description: Return latest factor and daily/weekly TD Sequential readings for one Yahoo Finance symbol, with session, price, rules, sources and historical index evidence. Reuses /api/market/indicators?ticker=; no chart histories. Stock implied volatility and variance risk premium are null; VIX term structure, credit and yield curve are shared market context. Evidence is not validated single-stock returns. Signals are rule readings, not forecasts or investment advice; the session may still be open. Each reading includes the previous session's value and signal.

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance symbol, case-insensitive, 1–20 characters after trimming: letters, digits, . - = ^; e.g. NVDA, BRK-B or 0700.HK.

tools.name: list_research_reports
tools.description: Return published TradingAgents report metadata and URLs newest first, the matching total and counts for all tickers. Use this to find reports before read_research_report, optionally filter by ticker and page with limit and offset.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. NVDA; case-insensitive, 1–32 characters after trimming. Omit to list all tickers.

limit.description: Maximum reports to return per call; integer from 1 to 100, default 20.

offset.description: Number of matching reports to skip, e.g. 20 for the next page with limit 20; integer from 0 to 9007199254740991, default 0.

tools.name: get_research_decisions
tools.description: Return every model's final portfolio decision for one ticker on its newest analysis date, or a chosen one: rating, report-time price, price target, confidence, time horizon and executive summary, with report URLs. Set includePrevious to compare each represented model's rating with its nearest earlier analysis date, with both source URLs and explicit missing/unavailable states. Same-date reruns use the latest run-start time; model names are not merged. No explanation of why a rating changed is inferred. Use read_research_report for reasoning.

ticker.description: Stock or ETF ticker, e.g. NVDA or SPY; case-insensitive, 1–32 characters after trimming.

date.description: Analysis date YYYY-MM-DD from list_research_reports. Omit for the newest.

includePrevious.description: Include each selected model's rating comparison with its nearest strictly earlier analysis date. Default false; not a comparison across models or reruns of the same date.

tools.name: read_research_report
tools.description: Return a full TradingAgents report as markdown, its ticker, date, model and URL, and an informational-only disclaimer; sections cover analyst reports, research decisions, trading plans, risk management and portfolio decisions. Use a url from list_research_reports for free access without sign-in.

url.description: A report url returned by list_research_reports; 1–2048 characters.

tools.name: get_research_signals
tools.description: Return the latest final portfolio decision per ticker as structured JSON, including report dates, models, source URLs and summaries. Optional tickers and since filters; ten-minute cache. Costs $0.01 USD per call by default via x402 payments inside MCP; the payment challenge gives the current price. Free sample: /api/research/signals/sample.

tickers.description: 1–100 comma-separated uppercase ticker symbols, e.g. NVDA,AAPL. Omit for all tickers.

since.description: Inclusive minimum analysis date, a valid YYYY-MM-DD date. Omit for all dates.
